description: This source file defines a final class 'ExecutionPool' that manages thread pools, scheduled execution, and delayed task handling via a DelayQueue. It includes methods for creating thread pools with custom thread factories, managing 'Pulse' objects that execute after delays, and retrieving future results from collections. It is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.base.concurrent package and involves multithreading and concurrency management.

classes.name: ExecutionPool
classes.description: Management of thread pools and delayed tasks, including creation and execution of scheduled and pulse worker threads.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolThreadFactory
classes.description: Custom thread factory for naming and daemonizing threads

classes.name: ExecutionPool.Pulse
classes.description: Abstract class representing a delayed, runnable task with expiration timing

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolPulseWorker
classes.description: Runnable worker that takes 'Pulse' objects from DelayQueue and executes their run method

methods.name: getScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with optional pre-start of threads

methods.name: getAllFutures
methods.description: Collects results of a collection of Futures, logging errors as they occur

methods.name: addPulse
methods.description: Adds a Pulse object to the DelayQueue for scheduled execution

methods.name: removePulse
methods.description: Removes a Pulse object from the DelayQueue
